longitudinal-sdr.reason: the six_regimens band and every reporting band are built on explicit BandOptions (longitudinal_sdr_properties.BAND_OPTIONS and REPORTING), so the default never reaches them; the band-finite-sample PR 1 run measured them

replay_rule: every non-band row of a refitted key: abs(new - committed) <= 1e-9 * max(1, abs(committed)) on truth, estimate, std_error and every other numeric column; property, cell, role, replicate, n, requested_replicates, failed_replicates, covered, rejected and every non-numeric column exactly.  A band row keeps every field but truth, estimate, std_error, covered and rejected

not_moved.simultaneous_coverage/k5__simultaneous_b: the gated cell reads the studentized bootstrap sup-t band: its statistic is the identity-scale max-t statistic of the pointwise control and its critical value the bootstrap's (long_horizon_properties.band_rows), so no multiplier option reaches it
